zh: 下标对的数量只取决于两边“每个值出现了几次”，所以维护两张值到频次的表就够了，更新 a[i] 只是让一个旧值减一、一个新值加一。
查询 x 时遍历两张频次表中不同值较少的那一张，对其中每个值 v，乘上另一张表里 x−v 的频次并累加。
建立 freqA、freqB；更新 0 i x：freqA[a[i]] 减 1（为 0 就删掉，保证不同值数量准确），a[i]+=x，freqA[a[i]] 加 1；查询 1 x：选不同值更少的一侧逐项累加 cnt[v]×另一侧[x−v]，用 64 位整数，结果按顺序以空格分隔输出（没有查询时输出空行）。
en: The number of index pairs depends only on how often each value appears on each side, so two value-to-frequency tables are enough; updating a[i] just moves one count from the old value to the new one.
For a query x, walk the frequency table with fewer distinct values and, for each value v in it, add its count times the frequency of x - v in the other table.

Build freqA and freqB; for update 0 i x decrement freqA[a[i]] (delete the entry when it reaches 0 so the distinct count stays exact), do a[i] += x and increment freqA[a[i]]; for query 1 x pick the side with fewer distinct values and sum cnt[v] * other[x - v] in 64-bit integers; print the answers in order separated by spaces (an empty line when there are no queries).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep the value frequencies of both a and b. An update decrements the count of a's old value and increments the count of the new value. For a query with target x, walk the side with fewer distinct values and add up `freqA[v] * freqB[x-v]`.

## Correctness

Every index pair (i,j) corresponds to exactly one pair of complementary values in the two arrays. Walking every distinct value v of the smaller frequency table and multiplying by the frequency of the target minus v on the other side counts exactly all pairs that satisfy the condition, so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice.

## Complexity

Let Da and Db be the numbers of distinct values on the two sides at the time of a query. An update takes O(1) expected time and a query O(min(Da,Db)); this site guarantees that this quantity summed over all queries is at most 10^7. Space is O(n+m).
